fn Power10(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 1 else (10 * Power10((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures ((not (n > 0)) or ((result % 10) == 0))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (Power10(0) == 1)
  example (Power10(1) == 10)
{
  if (n == 0) then 1 else (10 * Power10((n - 1)))
}

fn SumDigitsRecursive(n: Int, p: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (p >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if ((n == 0) or (p == 0)) then 0 else ((n / p) + SumDigitsRecursive((n % p), (p / 10)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (SumDigitsRecursive(0, 0) == 0)
  example (SumDigitsRecursive(1, 1) == 1)
{
  if ((n == 0) or (p == 0)) then 0 else ((n / p) + SumDigitsRecursive((n % p), (p / 10)))
}

fn NumberOfDigits(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if ((0 <= n) and (n <= 9)) then 1 else (1 + NumberOfDigits((n / 10)))))
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures ((result == 1) == ((0 <= n) and (n <= 9)))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (NumberOfDigits(0) == 1)
  example (NumberOfDigits(10) == 2)
{
  if ((0 <= n) and (n <= 9)) then 1 else (1 + NumberOfDigits((n / 10)))
}
